description: Add a vertical 'ribbon'/tape subtitle display capability to the OBS overlay (liveaudio/assets/subtitulos_obs.html) that stacks up to N most-recent lines vertically instead of replacing the single visible line, each aging out independently via smooth per-line enter/exit. Defines three modes via a new config key subtitle_display_mode=single|ribbon|adaptive, DEFAULT now 'adaptive' (LOCKED 2026-06-19, was single): single = legacy one-line behavior, the explicit opt-out for purists; ribbon = always stacked; adaptive (DEFAULT) = single-line under normal pacing and auto-expanding to the bounded ribbon ONLY when subtitles accumulate, then collapsing back. Adaptive is modeled as a SINGLE-RIBBON state machine that promotes when pendingQueue.length>1 OR a payload arrives with is_replay:true (engine.py:585), and demotes after full drain + one live line + a settle window reusing DEBOUNCE_MS (hysteresis, no flap, no flicker of surviving lines). Stacking direction is newest-on-TOP via flex-direction: column-reverse (OD-1 resolved). Per-line timers (sub._hideTimer/_cleanupTimer/_bornAt) replace the module-level singletons in the stacked branch, with an adoption protocol so boxes are not orphaned or double-removed across transitions. Backward compatibility under adaptive-default is preserved because adaptive is VISUALLY IDENTICAL to legacy single under normal one-at-a-time pacing; ?mode=single fully restores legacy behavior. Adds subtitle_ribbon_max_lines (default 3, clamp 1-8) in liveaudio/utils/config.py and an opt-in URL param ?mode=...&lines=N. The optional engine.py display_mode payload hint is DEFERRED (OD-5 resolved): this track touches ONLY config.py + the client overlay HTML (plus tests); engine.py and tests/test_engine.py are untouched. Adaptive is purely a client render decision and does not change what the server emits; note that the live_only backlog policy returns is_replay=False and may suppress the very backlog that would feed the ribbon (engine.py:208-209), so under live_only adaptive engages on client queue depth alone. Builds on top of the already-landed Track C (subtitle-legibility-anim) animation/legibility baseline, reusing its 0.3s animation, REVEAL_BUDGET_MS stagger cap, and 5000/650ms lifetime verbatim.
